name: Business software spending
question: Are businesses still paying for software?
metric: US private investment in software, adjusted for inflation, latest quarter, in billions of dollars a year
solvedIf: Businesses spend less because software gets cheap
trendLabel: US real private fixed investment in software, in billions of 2017 dollars a year.
caution: Higher spending can also mean software is more useful, so a rise does not prove it is far from solved. This counts investment by US businesses, and not all software purchases.
rule: Still rising when real investment is higher than a year before.
scoreReason: Against real GDP: Up 28% since ChatGPT launched.
